messages:
Lina (AE): Passing off SouthPoint Health — they committed to Dedicated with VPC + SSO. Need validation before trial ends in 10 days. Procurement flagged strict monthly cap; they will push back on any surprise overages.
Ravi (CSM): Thanks Lina. Can you confirm which Okta issuer and the primary procurement contact? Also any performance SLOs?
Lina (AE): Okta issuer: https://southpoint.okta.com. Contact: sean.procure@southpoint.org. SLO: p50 <110ms for short text prompts; peak burst expected ~1500 rps for anonymized triage model.
ProvisionBot: Ticket #CS-4905 created by Lina for Dedicated provisioning and SSO validation.
Priya (Support): Noted. I'll queue a staging load run and prepare the VPC peering checklist. Need their CIDR and whether they want route-based peering.
Marco (Eng): For Dedicated: require outbound 443 to control plane, 9443 for health streams, inbound only via peered NAT. Recommend /28 for NAT. If they plan private deploy we'll need mTLS certs and key rotation plan.
Ravi (CSM): I'll own the SSO walkthrough with their IdP team. Action owners: Lina - share Okta metadata & procurement ping; Marco - draft VPC peering doc; Priya - run baseline perf & share logs; Ravi - set renewal alert and own cost mitigation plan.
Lina (AE): Sent Okta metadata to Ravi, CC'd Sean. Also added contractual note: auto-renew unless flagged 30 days prior. Procurement insisted on a 60-day review window for budget approval.
Priya (Support): Baseline staging run: `hey -c200 -n10000 http://staging/southpoint` p50 102ms p95 240ms. We'll retest after Marco's kernel tweak.
Marco (Eng): I can try quantized runtime with prefix caching enabled on staging. Expect p95 down to ~150ms. Will deploy snapshot tonight (ts 1719962000).
Ravi (CSM): Customer worried about token costs during burst. I'll propose per-route throttles + soft quotas in Console and document expected cost per 1M tokens at committed tier. Agree to add to onboarding checklist.
Lina (AE): Procurement asks for a checkpoint 45 days before renewal and a usage report. Add Sean to the renewal playbook.
Priya (Support): After Marco's snapshot I'll rerun `hey` and attach the run logs here. If p95 <170ms we mark perf green for go-live.
Marco (Eng): Snapshot pushed (1719962000). If we still see p95 >170ms we'll enable extra batching and re-evaluate.
Ravi (CSM): Scheduling weekly touch: Fri 9am PT until go-live. I'll send invites to Lina, Marco, Priya, Sean. Also logging feature request: per-route cost insight in Console — will file FR ticket.
Lina (AE): Heads up: if we miss the 10-day window they may delay onboarding into next billing cycle -> renewal churn risk. Please prioritize SSO & perf. :warning:
Priya (Support): Acknowledged. I'll bump ticket priority to P1 and update #CS-4905 with test artifacts.
Marco (Eng): Drafted VPC peering runbook and shared in the ticket. Will include network ACLs and sample terraform snippet.
Ravi (CSM): Closing: capture learnings into onboarding playbook under "Dedicated + VPC + SSO" and note procurement checklist. I'll summarize after Fri sync. :memo:
